disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails. Lounge rules change on 1 July 2026. Other product changes are flagged from 15 May 2026.

joining.summary: The joining fee is ₹1,000 plus tax.

annual.summary: The renewal fee is ₹1,000 plus tax.

annual_waiver.summary: The renewal fee is waived on ₹3 lakh of annual spends.

base_earn.summary: The card earns 4 reward points per ₹200 of retail spend. The MITC lists a cycle cap of 50,000 reward points.

accelerated.summary: Online food spends on Swiggy and Zomato earn 20 reward points per ₹200. Additional 4X food points are capped at 2,500 reward points per calendar month. SmartBuy advertises up to 10X.

upi.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

redemption.summary: SmartBuy travel redeems at ₹0.50 per point. The exclusive catalogue is up to ₹0.35. Restaurants are ₹0.50. Cashback is ₹0.20.

expiry.summary: HDFC reward points typically remain valid for two years. Unused accounts for more than 365 days nullify points.

summary.summary: From 1 July 2026 lounge access is spend-gated on eligible spends in the previous calendar quarter. Use that rule rather than older marketing that said 2 domestic visits per quarter.

domestic.summary: From 1 July 2026 the quarterly allotment is 2 domestic lounge vouchers as part of 3 vouchers per calendar quarter.

conditions.summary: Spend at least ₹60,000 of eligible spend in the previous calendar quarter.

international.summary: From 1 July 2026 the quarterly allotment includes 1 international lounge voucher as part of 3 vouchers per calendar quarter.

conditions.summary: Spend at least ₹60,000 of eligible spend in the previous calendar quarter.

railway.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

dining.summary: Participating restaurants advertise an extra 10 percent off on Dineout.

movies.summary: BookMyShow weekend buy-one-get-one applies with a maximum of ₹250 per ticket and 2 free tickets per calendar month on Friday through Sunday shows.

golf.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

travel.summary: Emergency overseas hospitalisation cover is USD 31,250. Baggage delay cover is USD 625.

milestones.summary: Spending ₹75,000 in the first 90 days unlocks complimentary Swiggy One and Times Prime annual memberships. Spending ₹1.5 lakh in a quarter unlocks a ₹1,500 voucher from a listed partner set. Lounge unlocks at ₹60,000 eligible spend in the previous quarter from July 2026.

welcome.summary: Welcome memberships are Swiggy One and Times Prime after ₹75,000 spend in the first 90 days.
